title: Design, synthesis, and neuroprotective evaluation of chiral butylphthalide-ligustrazine hybrids via the Keap1-Nrf2 pathway in ischemic stroke.
authors: Zuo, Chenwei; Xie, Haochen; Shen, Haoyue; Wang, Jiaxin; Li, Guangyu; Hou, Quanxing; Sun, Guibo; Tian, Yu
one_liner_zh: 该文为小分子药物设计与神经保护活性研究，涉及Keap1-Nrf2通路分子对接，但无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，亦无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: As a racemate, 3-n-butylphthalide (NBP) can be separated into its S- and R-enantiomers, with S-NBP reported to exhibit superior bioactivity. To develop more potent anti-stroke agents with enhanced bioavailability, we therefore employed S-NBP as the lead compound. Through structural modification and hybridization with ligustrazine (TMP), 20 novel S-NBP-TMP hybrids were designed and synthesized. In vitro screening for neuroprotection using OGD/R-injured HT22 cells and primary hippocampal neurons identified compounds S8g, S8h, and S8i. At 12.5 muM, these compounds significantly enhanced cell viability recovery compared to both their racemates and NBP. Among them, S8i exhibited the most potent neuroprotective activity, outperforming even S-NBP. Subsequent mechanistic studies demonstrated that S8i effectively attenuated OGD/R-induced mitochondrial damage and oxidative stress, while also reducing both neuronal apoptosis and necrosis. Molecular docking revealed that S8i effectively occupies the Keap1 binding pocket for Nrf2 and forms four hydrogen bonds with Arg380, Arg415, and Ser555. Moreover, S8i exhibits favorable BBB permeability, as its Pe value (21.95 x 10(-6) cm/s) significantly exceeds the penetration threshold. In vivo studies demonstrated that S8i ameliorated cerebral ischemia-reperfusion injury, restored cerebral blood flow, and protected cerebral vasculature in MCAO/R model mice. Furthermore, at doses of 30 and 60 mg/kg, S8i exhibited significantly superior efficacy to NBP (90 mg/kg). Additionally, S8i downregulated Keap1 expression and upregulated the expression of Nrf2 and its downstream factors, HO-1 and NQO-1 in vivo. In summary, S8i demonstrates significantly enhanced neuroprotection versus its racemate, NBP, and S-NBP, positioning it as a highly promising lead compound for ischemic stroke therapy.
abstract_zh: 作为外消旋体，3-正丁基苯酞（NBP）可拆分为其S-和R-对映体，其中S-NBP据报道具有更优的生物活性。为开发具有更强效力和更好生物利用度的抗卒中药物，我们因此以S-NBP为先导化合物。通过结构修饰并与川芎嗪（TMP）杂交，设计并合成了20个新型S-NBP-TMP杂合体。利用OGD/R损伤的HT22细胞和原代海马神经元进行体外神经保护筛选，鉴定出化合物S8g、S8h和S8i。在12.5 μM浓度下，这些化合物与它们的外消旋体及NBP相比，显著增强了细胞活力恢复。其中，S8i表现出最强的神经保护活性，甚至优于S-NBP。随后的机制研究表明，S8i有效减轻了OGD/R诱导的线粒体损伤和氧化应激，同时减少了神经元凋亡和坏死。分子对接显示，S8i有效占据Nrf2的Keap1结合口袋，并与Arg380、Arg415和Ser555形成四个氢键。此外，S8i表现出良好的血脑屏障（BBB）通透性，其Pe值（21.95 x 10(-6) cm/s）显著超过穿透阈值。体内研究表明，S8i改善了MCAO/R模型小鼠的脑缺血再灌注损伤，恢复了脑血流量，并保护了脑血管。此外，在30和60 mg/kg剂量下，S8i表现出显著优于NBP（90 mg/kg）的疗效。进一步地，S8i在体内下调了Keap1表达，并上调了Nrf2及其下游因子HO-1和NQO-1的表达。总之，S8i与其外消旋体、NBP和S-NBP相比，表现出显著增强的神经保护作用，使其成为缺血性卒中治疗极具前景的先导化合物。
